name.taken.message: A digest called “{name}” already exists. Pick another name.

feed.required: Give the feed's address, or pick a connected WordPress site.
feed.site: Pick a connected WordPress site, or give a feed address instead.

feed.address.note: detail: why the address can't be used, a sentence from internal/digests/feed's messages

categories.none: Pick at least one category. With none, every post is left out and every issue is skipped.
schedule.frequency: Pick daily, weekly, monthly or when new items arrive.
schedule.timezone: Pick a time zone from the list.
schedule.count: Send when 1 to 50 new items arrive.
schedule.window: Give the sending window as two times, such as 08:00 and 18:00.

schedule.windowOrder.message: The window ends after it starts: pick an end time later than {from, time}.
schedule.windowOrder.note: from: the window's start, on the reader's clock (18:00, 6:00 PM)

schedule.time: Give the send time as HH:MM, such as 08:00.
schedule.weekday: Pick a day of the week.
schedule.monthDay: Pick a day of the month, 1 to 31.
prepare.range: Prepare 1 to 24 hours before the send time.
late.values: The late limit is 6, 24 or 48 hours.
audience.required: Pick who the issues go to: a list or a segment.
audience.unknown: One of the lists or segments doesn't exist any more. Pick the audience again.
sender.unknown: That sender doesn't exist. Pick another From.
start.latest: Include the latest 1 to 20 items in the first issue.

on.needsSend.message: Sending each issue automatically needs campaigns:send. You can turn it on in draft mode: each issue becomes a draft you send through Review & send.
on.needsSend.note: a member without campaigns:send tried to turn on a digest that sends automatically

on.needsFeed: The feed hasn't been read yet. Read it once before turning the digest on.
on.needsAudience: Pick an audience before turning the digest on.
on.needsTemplate: Design the email before turning the digest on: its template is empty.

pause.reason.note: why an issue's send paused, on its live monitor

delete.on: Pause the digest before deleting it: it is on.
issue.notOpen: That issue isn't waiting any more: it was sent or skipped.
issue.releaseNotHeld: Only a held issue can be released.

issue.releaseBlocked.message: Send Readiness still blocks the issue ({count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}). Fix it first, then release it.

issue.rebuildState: Only a prepared issue that hasn't started sending can be rebuilt.
issue.noTemplate: The digest has no template to build issues from. Design the email first.
issue.noItems: There are no new posts to build the next issue from.

issue.ownerLost.note: why an issue was skipped, quoted after “by”; permission: campaigns:send

problem.readinessUnavailable: Send Readiness isn't available in this process.
problem.readinessRunning: Send Readiness is running for this issue. Try again when it finishes.
problem.testsUnavailable: Test sends aren't available in this process.

problem.templateRender.note: detail: the Liquid error, in English

feed.failed.note: detail: why the feed couldn't be read, in English

feed.noLink.message: {address} is a web page that links to no feed. Give the feed's own address.

feed.tryTimedOut.note: a read of the feed at preparation that took too long, after its time

version.starter.message: created from the Blog digest starter
version.starter.note: the template's first version in its history; Blog digest is a starter's name

version.prepared.message: Issue #{number}, prepared from {count, plural, one {# new post} other {# new posts}}
version.prepared.note: an issue's version in its history

version.next: Next issue as it would be built now

starter.name.note: a new recurring digest's name until it is renamed, written in its email's language; host: the blog's (blog.acme.io)

starter.subject.note: the starter email's subject, a Liquid template kept as written. title: the first post's title; count: how many more posts; feed: the feed's title; start and end wrap the words shown only with two posts or more. Keep every placeholder

starter.preheader.note: the starter email's preheader, kept as written; host: the blog's (blog.acme.io); number: the issue's number

notify.pausedRole.message: {digest} paused: {owner}'s role changed from {from} to {to}, so issues can't send on their authority. Anyone with campaigns:send can turn it back on and becomes its owner.
notify.pausedRole.note: digest: its name; owner: a member's name; from, to: role names

notify.pausedLost: {digest} paused: {owner} no longer has campaigns:send in this workspace. Anyone with campaigns:send can turn it back on and becomes its owner.
notify.pausedOwnerSummary: {digest} paused: its owner can't send any more
notify.pausedFeed: {digest} paused after three issues in a row were skipped because the feed failed. Check the feed, then turn it back on.

notify.pausedBy.message: {name} paused {digest}. No new issues are prepared until it is turned back on.

notify.pausedByNote.message: {name} paused {digest}. No new issues are prepared until it is turned back on. “{note}”
notify.pausedByNote.note: note: what they wrote, as typed

notify.pausedAnon: Someone paused {digest}. No new issues are prepared until it is turned back on.
notify.pausedAnonNote: Someone paused {digest}. No new issues are prepared until it is turned back on. “{note}”

notify.heldNoApprovers.message: {issue} is held: the approval rules match it and no one other than its owner can approve it. Give campaigns:approve to another role, or skip the issue before {date}, {time}.
notify.heldNoApprovers.note: issue: the digest's name and the issue's number (Weekly Digest #143); date, time: the late limit

notify.heldChanges: {issue} is held: an approver asked for changes. Edit the issue, then release it before {date}, {time}.
notify.heldRejected: {issue} is held: an approver rejected it. Edit and release it, or skip it, before {date}, {time}.

notify.heldBlocked.message: {issue} is held: {block}. Fix it or skip the issue before {date}, {time}.
notify.heldBlocked.note: block: the Send Readiness check that blocks it, as it names itself

notify.heldReadiness: {issue} is held: Send Readiness is Blocked. Fix it or skip the issue before {date}, {time}.
notify.draftBody: {issue} is a draft with {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}. Send it through Review & send by {date}, {time}.

notify.feedFailing.message: {digest}'s feed failed at preparation: {why}. ReputeCast tries again every 15 minutes; if it still fails at {time}, the issue is skipped.
notify.feedFailing.note: why: what went wrong, from internal/digests/feed's messages; time: the send time

notify.feedFailingUnknown: {digest}'s feed failed at preparation: it couldn't be read. ReputeCast tries again every 15 minutes; if it still fails at {time}, the issue is skipped.

notify.feedSkipped.message: {digest}'s issue was skipped: its feed, {address}, couldn't be read by the send time. Its posts stay new for the next issue.
notify.feedSkipped.note: address: the feed's address without https://
